howto.name: Upload files
howto.text: Drop multiple files of any type, up to 500 MB in total.

howto.name: Choose compression level
howto.text: Slide from 0 (Store, no compression) through Fast and Balanced (the default, level 6) to Smallest size at 9.

howto.name: Download the ZIP
howto.text: All files are bundled into a single .zip with their original filenames and extensions.

faq.a: Not yet. Create ZIP produces standard, unencrypted ZIP archives; password-protected archives are not supported.

No. Every file is placed at the root of the archive, and a file whose name is already taken gets a numbered suffix. There is no folder option; to keep a folder structure, zip the folder on your own device.

faq.q: What compression level should I choose?
faq.a: Balanced is best for most files. Store is fastest for already-compressed files like JPG, MP4, and PDF. Smallest size can shrink text-heavy files more but takes longer.
